entities.summary: Adolf Dietrich was a Swiss laborer and artist associated with New Objectivity. He is one of the most renowned Swiss naïve artists and painters of the 20th century. Adolf Dietrich was a painters & sculptors from Berlingen (1877-11-09, Berlingen–1957-06-04). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
